title: A monic polynomial is a nonzerodivisor
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $f\in R[T]$ a monic polynomial in the polynomial ring in one variable [def-weil-polynomial-ring] (its leading coefficient is $1$). Then $f$ is a nonzerodivisor of $R[T]$: if $g\in R[T]$ and $fg=0$, then $g=0$.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07BV (lemma-colimit-syntomic, line 44527), lines 44548-44550: 'Then it is clear that P_1, ..., P_r is a regular sequence', each P_i being monic in Y_i; tag verified in stacks-project/tags/tags (07BV,algebra-lemma-colimit-syntomic). The fact itself: if g has leading coefficient a ≠ 0 and degree e, the coefficient of T^{deg f + e} in fg is a.
